name: hangvidu
description: P2P video chat with watch-together mode
author: Kristinn Roach

scripts.build: pnpm p2p:prod && vp check && VITE_HANGVIDU_API_URL=https://api.hangvidu.com vp build
scripts.dev: pnpm kill:silent && VITE_HANGVIDU_API_URL=https://localhost:8788 concurrently -k -n vite,cloudflare "vp dev" "pnpm dev:cf"
scripts.dev:mobile: pnpm kill:silent && VITE_HANGVIDU_API_URL=https://api.hangvidu.com concurrently -k -n vite,tunnel "vp dev" "cloudflared --no-autoupdate tunnel --config /dev/null --url https://localhost:5173 --no-tls-verify run vidu-dev"
scripts.deploy:cf: pnpm lint:cf && pnpm test:cf && pnpm -C backend/cloudflare run deploy
scripts.p2p:prod: readlink node_modules/@kidlib/p2p | grep -q .pnpm || (pnpm unlink @kidlib/p2p && pnpm install)
scripts.deploy:fb: SENTRY_UPLOAD=true pnpm build && pnpm test:compat && firebase deploy --only hosting && pnpm sentry:deploy
scripts.deploy:fb:skip-tests: SENTRY_UPLOAD=true pnpm build && firebase deploy --only hosting && pnpm sentry:deploy
scripts.deploy:all: SENTRY_UPLOAD=true pnpm build && pnpm install:fb:functions && pnpm test:compat && firebase deploy && pnpm sentry:deploy
scripts.deploy:all:skip-tests: SENTRY_UPLOAD=true pnpm build && pnpm install:fb:functions && firebase deploy && pnpm sentry:deploy
scripts.check:cf:api: curl -fsS --max-time 10 https://api.hangvidu.com/health && echo ' ✅ worker + D1 healthy' || (echo '❌ worker unhealthy (down or D1 unreachable)'; exit 1)
scripts.check:fb:functions: if curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 -X POST https://europe-west1-vidu-aae11.cloudfunctions.net/sendCallNotification | grep -E '400|401|405' -q; then echo '✅ push Cloud Function is ready'; else echo '❌ push Cloud Function not ready'; exit 1; fi
scripts.check:fb:rtdb: if curl -s --max-time 10 'https://vidu-aae11-default-rtdb.europe-west1.firebasedatabase.app/.json?shallow=true' | grep -Eq 'Permission denied|appcheck'; then echo '✅ RTDB reachable (access enforced)'; else echo '❌ RTDB unreachable or access checks misbehaving'; exit 1; fi
scripts.check:prod: f=0; pnpm check:cf:api || f=1; pnpm check:fb:hosting || f=1; pnpm check:fb:functions || f=1; pnpm check:fb:rtdb || f=1; exit $f
scripts.play:rtdb-live: fkill :8080 :8081 --silent; node --env-file=.env.development ./playgrounds/rtdb-proxy.js & python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory . & sleep 0.5 && open http://localhost:8080/playgrounds/rtdb-live.html && wait
scripts.play:boundaries: pnpm play:boundaries:scan && fkill :8082 --silent; python3 -m http.server 8082 --directory . & sleep 0.5 && open http://localhost:8082/playgrounds/boundary-rules.html && wait
scripts.preview: pnpm kill:silent && pnpm build && concurrently -k -n preview,tunnel "vp preview" "cloudflared tunnel run vidu-dev"
scripts.test:compat: vp run setup:browsers && vp test --project node && COMPAT=true vp test --project browser
